name: rootcode
description: Rootcode builds a living dependency graph of your codebase, trains a personalized agent on your internal patterns, conventions, and engineering history, and delivers code suggestions that don’t just work — they fit. No more generically correct code that violates your architecture. The longer your team uses it, the smarter it gets.

chatParticipants.name: rootcode
chatParticipants.description: Develop, test, commit and review code with Rootcode's agents

rootcode.agent.modelSource.description: baseten-model-api: Baseten's hosted Model APIs (inference.baseten.co). trained-endpoint: the LoRA deployment saved by the trainer in .repo2lora/rootcode-endpoint.json.

rootcode.agent.baseUrl.description: Override the OpenAI-compatible base URL (default https://inference.baseten.co/v1). Uses the same Baseten API key as training.

rootcode.agent.model.description: Override the model slug (default meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026, the hackathon model).

rootcode.agent.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for Muse Spark Open (it always reasons; Baseten's default is xhigh, which is slow for agents). Empty = Baseten default.

rootcode.agent.maxTokens.description: max_tokens per model call, including reasoning tokens.

rootcode.agent.sandboxImage.description: Docker image the QA agent uses for sandboxed test runs

rootcode.memory.enabled.description: Let Rootcode Recall learn from how you use agent responses (edits, errors, tests, git reverts) and apply those lessons in future sessions for this project.

rootcode.memoryTrackingWindowMs.description: How long (ms) Rootcode watches your edits after an agent response to learn whether it helped.

loraTrainer.fireworksApiKey.description: FireworksAI API key (falls back to FIREWORKS_API_KEY env var)

loraTrainer.basetenApiKey.description: Baseten API key (falls back to BASETEN_API_KEY env var)

loraTrainer.baseModel.description: Base model to fine-tune. Empty = meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026 on Baseten, accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct on Fireworks

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:workflow: npm run compile-tests && mocha --ui tdd out/test/workflow.test.js
